title: docs: re-fence the basic, data-display, feedback and form remainder of objectui#5867 as ts, 39 blocks across 39 component pages (batch 7)
body:
Refs #5867 (batch 7)
Clause-②: no. A docs fence-language and compile pass; no contract or accept set moves.

Batch 7 of objectui#5867's lane. Every TypeScript block that triage's classifier reads as code under `content/docs/components/{basic,data-display,feedback,form}/**` was fenced `plaintext`, so `check-doc-snippet-types` never compiled it. All 39 of them are now fenced `ts`. Three then failed to compile, and each is fixed in the block itself; none is marked as a fragment, and no component type or gate logic moved.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`

## Population, re-measured on `main` `5262f7dd3`

Measured with `node scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs --list` (the gate's own walk and triage's classifier). The whole remainder was 72 blocks in 72 files, all under `content/docs/components/**`. The four subgroups held 41; two are excluded by the claim, so the batch is **39 blocks in 39 files**.

| subgroup | before (blocks / files) | re-fenced `ts` | red on first compile | after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| basic | 9 / 9 | 8 | 0 | 1: `basic/text.mdx`, excluded while PR #11069 is open |
| data-display | 8 / 8 | 8 | 1: `list.mdx`, TS2304 `SchemaNode` | 0 |
| feedback | 8 / 8 | 8 | 1: `empty.mdx`, TS2304 `SchemaNode` | 0 |
| form | 16 / 16 | 15 | 1: `calendar.mdx`, TS2304 `Day` x8 | 1: `form/file-upload.mdx`, its own labelled ledger line |
| **total** | **41 / 41** | **39** | **3** | **2** |

The other five subgroups (complex 9, disclosure 3, layout 8, navigation 1, overlay 10) are batch 8 and are untouched. After this PR the fence gate's remainder is 33 blocks in 33 files. These figures are readings at the heads named below; the live number is that `--list`, and nothing re-derives this table.

All 39 blocks are self-declared `interface` listings, so they belong to the separate #6143 own-interface count. The compile now proves that every member type resolves; it does not judge the member rows against the shipped schema.

## The three fixes

- `data-display/list.mdx` and `feedback/empty.mdx` used `SchemaNode` without declaring it. Both now import it with `import type { SchemaNode } from '@object-ui/types';`, which is what `layout/box.mdx` already does.
- `form/calendar.mdx` used `Day`, a prose alias. The shipped `CalendarDay` in `packages/types/src/form.ts` is not exported, so the block declares `type Day = Date | string;` locally, with the page's own gloss as a trailing comment. The declaration sits on the block's first line, so if this block is ever fenced `plaintext` again, the fence gate's classifier still flags it (the classifier reads `type X =`).

## `KNOWN_UNHIGHLIGHTED_TS_FENCES`: 39 rows deleted, none added

This follows the card's standing rule (authorisation comment 5905984416): a batch deletes the zero-count rows of its own re-fenced pages. `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` has 0 lines added and 39 deleted, every one a map row; no number was raised and the gate logic is untouched. The deleted rows, all under `content/docs/components/`:

- `basic/`: `button-group`, `html`, `icon`, `image`, `navigation-menu`, `pagination`, `separator`, `sidebar` (8)
- `data-display/`: `alert`, `avatar`, `badge`, `breadcrumb`, `kbd`, `list`, `statistic`, `tree-view` (8)
- `feedback/`: `empty`, `loading`, `progress`, `skeleton`, `sonner`, `spinner`, `toast`, `toaster` (8)
- `form/`: `button`, `calendar`, `checkbox`, `combobox`, `command`, `date-picker`, `form`, `input-otp`, `input`, `label`, `radio-group`, `select`, `slider`, `switch`, `textarea` (15)

`basic/text.mdx` and `form/file-upload.mdx` keep their rows. This time the edit was not refused.

## Beyond the claim's file surface: two test readers and an empty changeset

Two `@object-ui/types` tests parse a page's interface out of its `plaintext` fence by regex. They threw once the fence became `ts`, so each one now follows its page. This is outside the claim's declared surface; it is stated here so the seat can amend the surface.

- `button-group-doc-surface-6347.test.ts` reads `basic/button-group.mdx`'s one `ts` fence. No assertion changed.
- `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts` reads six pages. `feedback/empty.mdx` is now `ts`, while the five overlay pages stay `plaintext` until batch 8. Each subject now names its fence language (`fence: 'ts'` for `EmptySchema`, `'plaintext'` for the overlay subjects), and the reader takes it as a required argument. No assertion changed.

Both files live under `packages/types/src/`, so `check-changeset-presence` counts them as published source. `.changeset/5867-plaintext-fenced-ts-batch7.md` has an empty frontmatter and declares that nothing is released.

## Verification

Every reading is at head `1f9701af` (tree clean, `main` unmoved at `5262f7dd3`, so the merge of `origin/main` is a no-op), unless a line says otherwise. Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, with a memory watchdog.

- **Build:** `turbo run build` over the gate's own `--build-filter` closure: 35/35 tasks, exit 0. After that build, only the two test files under `packages/types/src/__tests__` changed in `packages/`, and the published build excludes them.
- **`check:doc-snippets`:**
  - before (the base bytes of the surface, restored under a trap): exit 0, 854 covered blocks, 698 to compile, 129 documents holding a ts block, 0 failed;
  - round 1 (re-fence only, `0960c9fb`): exit 1, 737 to compile, 3 failed, all TS2304 (`SchemaNode` in list and empty, `Day` x8 in calendar);
  - after: exit 0, 893 covered, **737 to compile (+39, exactly the batch)**, 167 documents holding a ts block (+38, because `icon.mdx` already held one), fragments 156 and ungated 4 unchanged, `Semantic phase: 737 of 737 block(s) judged, 0 failed.`
- **`check:doc-fences`:** `--self-test` 26 cases pass. The gate exits 0, with 33 declared files carrying 33 blocks (it was 72 / 72 at base).
- **Ablation, red as predicted:** `ablation-replace.mjs` turned `list.mdx`'s `ts` opener back to `plaintext`. The anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob changed. `check:doc-fences` exited 1 with `1 TypeScript block(s) under an unhighlighted fence, beyond the baseline`, naming `content/docs/components/data-display/list.mdx`. That is the FRESH mode, because the file's row is gone. The restore was proven: blob equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Other docs gates:** `check:doc-types` exit 0 (`Every documented component type is registered.`) · `check-prompt-component-keys` exit 0 · `check:doc-example-ids` exit 0 · `docs:check-links` exit 0 (`Links are valid across 17 scan roots.`) · `check:doc-examples` exit 0 · `check:docs-route-closure` exit 0 · `check:control-bytes` exit 0, plus a self-scan of the 43 changed files with 0 hits · `check:new-line-citations` 0 new.
- **Changesets:** `check-changeset-presence` exit 0 (one empty-frontmatter changeset) · `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0.
- **Tests:**
  - The readers of these pages are the union of `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list` (every `content/docs/**` and `content/docs/components/**` reader, plus the named button-group and empty readers) and a `git grep` for the four subgroup paths: 28 files. Run from the repo root: `Test Files 28 passed (28)`, `Tests 1009 passed (1009)`.
  - A basename cross-check found no further reader.
  - The first run, before the overlay reader was fixed, was `1 failed | 27 passed` on `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts`.
  - `vitest run scripts/__tests__/`: `Test Files 177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests 5371 passed | 2 skipped (5373)`.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes both edited tests.
- **Lint, narrowed:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 43 changed files gives 43 results. 40 are `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied.` (the 39 mdx pages and the changeset), and 3 are linted with 0 errors and 0 warnings. No `project` or `projectService` is configured, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- **NOT MEASURED:**
  - external link checking (lychee), reason: CI only;
  - site render, reason: no site build was run (`basic/icon.mdx` and `layout/box.mdx` already render a `ts` fence through the same highlighter).

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- `basic/div.mdx` and `basic/span.mdx` each hold a `plaintext` fence whose body is a TypeScript `interface`. Each block's first line is a `// DEPRECATED` comment, so triage's first-line classifier reads them as prose. They are outside the fence gate's population and its ledger, and outside this batch. The gate's header quotes the classifier on purpose rather than extending it, so this is its declared edge, not a defect.
- Batch 8 will meet three more doc-pin readers that extract an overlay page's interface from a `plaintext` fence: `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts` (flip the five `fence: 'plaintext'` subjects), `alert-dialog-read-dialect-7104.test.ts` and `overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts`.
